title: RBAC v2 staged migration: backfill verification automation, audit continuity safeguards, and customer readiness comms
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: Automate verification of RBAC v2 backfills and dual-write reconciliation, ensure continuous audit logging and SSO/SAML mapping correctness during phased cutover, and coordinate customer readiness communications. Deliverables: backfill verifier job, reconciliation playbooks, automated smoke tests for SSO mapping, audit-forwarding validation, templated customer notice and opt-in checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Automated backfill verifier runs nightly and reports mismatches to #rbac-migration-alerts
Dual-write reconciliation job detects >=99.95% parity and alerts otherwise
Audit logging continuity validated: no gaps during handoff windows as shown on audit-forwarding dashboard
SSO/SAML attribute mapping smoke tests pass for 5 pilot customers before canary
Customer readiness email + migration checklist approved by PM and Legal
implementation_plan: 1) Build backfill verifier as idempotent Spark job (owner: infra-team) with golden snapshot comparison
2) Instrument dual-write to emit reconciliation tombstones and per-entity checksums
3) Create audit-forwarder test harness to replay events and assert destination parity
4) Implement SSO mapping smoke test runner that runs against staging SAML IdP test apps
5) Run pilot with two internal teams, then three external pilot customers
6) Execute canary week with rolling cutover and fallback automation
7) Post-cutover: run 7-day parity monitor before marking done
test_plan: Unit tests for verifier logic with seeded mismatch cases
Integration tests: dual-write enabled on staging with synthetic traffic
End-to-end: simulate role grants/releases while asserting audit timeline continuity
SSO/SAML: automated SAML assertion replay against test IdP and validate role mapping
Chaos test: kill the backfill job mid-run to validate resumability and alerting
observability_checks: Alerts: PagerDuty if parity_rate < 99.9% sustained for 10m, or audit.forward_lag_seconds > 300s
Logs: include entity_id, prior_version, target_version, reconciliation_action in structured logs
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Large customer orgs may have thousands of roles; backfill may exceed maintenance window => Mitigation: prioritize incremental backfill with prefix caching and rate-limiting, schedule maintenance windows per customer
Risk: Dual-write divergence due to transient errors => Mitigation: tombstone-based reconciliation and automatic retry queue with dead-letter monitoring
Risk: SSO mapping differences cause access regressions => Mitigation: preflight smoke tests + per-customer mapping report and opt-out
Risk: Audit logs gaps during cutover => Mitigation: audit-forwarder buffered persistence with sequence checking and replays
comments: 2025-02-12 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting held. Agreed on verifier approach using golden snapshot comparisons. Decided to prioritize audit continuity over speed for first pilot.
2025-02-18 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented initial backfill verifier prototype. Found schema drift in role_version field for legacy tenants; created ENG-50345 to normalize.
2025-02-24 - Security Review (Marta Reyes): Requested explicit retention policy check for forwarded audit events and KMS key rotation steps. Marked security_review_required true.
2025-02-28 - Design feedback (Tobias Lee): Recommended UI column showing 'last-reconciled' timestamp in Console for affected orgs. Filed DES-231 for Console work.
2025-03-01 - PM (Noah Wang): Drafted customer readiness notice; Legal requested softer language around rollback procedures - updated template.
2025-03-03 - QA (Priya Sharma): Smoke tests for SAML mapping added; two mismatches discovered for pilot-org-2 attributes -> created follow-up task ENG-50367.
customer_communication_template:
Subject: Upcoming RBAC migration window and what to expect
Hello {customer_name},
We are preparing to migrate your organization to our RBAC v2 authorization system. This migration improves role consistency, audit fidelity, and SSO mapping accuracy. Planned migration window: {date-window}. What we will do: run a non-destructive verification pass, perform role backfill, and then switch policy evaluation to RBAC v2. What we need from you: confirm test admin account and review SSO attribute mappings. If you prefer to delay, reply to opt-out by {opt-out-date}. Support: support@redwood.ai
post_migration_checks: 7-day parity monitor report generated daily and posted to #rbac-migration-reports
Manual audit sample of 100 random grants per large org at day-1 and day-3
Customer success check-in scheduled at day-2 and day-7 post-cutover
